name: @agentpost/openclaw-tools
description: OpenClaw tool plugin for the AgentPost public HTTP protocol

scripts.plugin:build: npm run build && openclaw plugins build --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.plugin:check: npm run build && openclaw plugins build --check --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.plugin:validate: npm run plugin:build && openclaw plugins validate --entry ./dist/index.js
